title: Api error
description: The body of every non-2xx answer of the REST API. `code` is a stable machine-readable token the frontend may branch on, `message` is one English sentence for a technician and `details` carries whatever helps to debug the call. No key, no prompt and no state digest ever appears here.

error.description: The one error the request produced.

code.description: Stable token naming the failure, for example bad_request, not_found or upstream_unavailable.

message.description: One English sentence a technician can read.

details.description: Anything that helps to debug the call: the offending field, the validation issues, the upstream status.
